verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a free or Basic tier, a published free storage quota, or whether free accounts use the same clients and API. The plans-page snippets cover transfer limits and restore windows, not a free plan's storage allowance. Pricing tiers are a fair axis for a cloud storage product, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a power user, I can start free — a real free tier with published storage quota that works with the same clients and API
